chapters: 1. Collect transitions and store them in a buffer
Policy actions produce simulator transitions: state, action, reward, next state, done.
Sample sequences, warm up the GRU, predict future states, and minimize prediction loss.
3. Train the policy in the simulator first
Before the switch: simulator rollouts provide the rewards and transitions for PPO.
3. Switch policy training to the world model
After warm-start: imagined transitions and custom rewards drive PPO updates.
Collect fresh transitions, update the world model, then update the policy again.
Separate simulator-trained baseline 1199; this footage is not an online world-model training result.
methodology_note: Requested intended sequence includes simulator PPO before switching to WM PPO. Current online implementation collects data and fits WM during warm-start but does not yet perform those initial simulator PPO updates.
footage_note: Separately trained simulator baseline, not a policy produced by the illustrated WM training run.
